meta.title: IPFS Attest Hubzilla Post
meta.purpose: Prepare an authenticated user's latest own Hubzilla post as an attestation package, then later publish, pin, and POSIX-map it through the controlled IPFS/orchestrator backend.

objects.label: Verification boundary
objects.default: Verify Profile checks that the selected profile resolves to orchestrator1 and matches backend role ipfs_publication. It does not publish, pin, unpin, write git/POSIX paths, expose credentials, or call raw Kubo RPC from the browser.

objects.label: Profile status
objects.default:
Connection status: not checked
Capability status: available
Execution active: false
Backend role: ipfs_publication
Authority boundary safe: not checked

objects.default:

profile_id: ipfs-publication-default
target: orchestrator1
orchestrator: orchestrator1.internal.diagnostics.kane-il.us
backend_role: ipfs_publication
backend_node: ipfs1.diagnostics.kane-il.us
raw_kubo_rpc_exposed: false
raw_git_write_exposed: false
status: available

Attestation operation now active:
attestation.package.prepare

objects.label: Automatic source rule
objects.default: Webforms uses the latest eligible post authored by the authenticated current channel. There is no post picker in the first deployment. Visitors and sessions without a current channel cannot create an Attestation.

objects.label: Resolver work
objects.default: Hubzilla/Webforms resolves the latest eligible local item, enriches it through Hubzilla core, encodes it with the native Nomad/Zot6 path, and collects dreport delivery rows. Orchestrator does not query the Hubzilla database or reconstruct the post.

objects.label: Resolved fields
objects.default: item_id | uuid | mid | channel_hash | xchan_hash | created | edited | body_sha256 | sig_sha256 | payload_sha256 | payload_size_bytes | delivery_report_count | retrieval_status

notes: The portable package JSON does not contain the raw orchestrator URL, raw Kubo RPC endpoint, git write path, service credentials, or pinset mutation authority.
Visitors cannot create an Attestation because there is no authenticated current channel.
The first deployment uses the latest eligible own post from the authenticated current channel; older events should be recorded by publishing a new post and attesting that latest post.
Prepare Package stores the prepared attestation package on orchestrator1; IPFS publish, pin, and POSIX mapping remain inactive.
